channel.title: DONOR CLASS | Who Funds the U.S. Congress?
channel.description: Nonpartisan campaign finance intelligence platform tracking over $277,000,000 across all 539 members of the U.S. Congress based on official public FEC disclosures.

item.title: Day 2: California Congressional Delegation ($25.57M Tracked across 54 Lawmakers)
item.description: Our research desk tracked $25,571,776 across all 54 California lawmakers based on official public FEC disclosures. Foreign policy advocacy PACs contributed $16.85M (96% penetration), Silicon Valley tech PACs allocated $1.87M (91%), and labor unions contributed $1.67M. Top recipients span both parties: Rep. Jimmy Gomez ($2.59M), Rep. Pete Aguilar ($1.70M), and Rep. Ken Calvert ($1.33M).

item.title: Day 1: Texas Congressional Delegation ($14.15M Tracked across 39 Lawmakers)
item.description: Our research desk mapped $14,152,840 across all 39 Texas lawmakers in the 118th/119th Congress based on official FEC filings. Fossil fuel and energy PACs lead with $4.49M (95% penetration), while defense contractors backed 37 of 39 lawmakers ($3.12M). PAC capital follows committee power and seniority across party lines.
